report.reportPurpose: Native-resolution Live renderer and progressive Studio surface path tracer. Studio samples/s is not an animation frame-rate claim. Physical Android has not been measured.
report.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) HeadlessChrome/144.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

gpu.shadingLanguage: WebGL GLSL ES 3.00 (OpenGL ES GLSL ES 3.0 Chromium)

report.renderer: Progressive ten-bounce triangle path tracer; finite area lights, MIS, anisotropic GGX surfaces, solid analytic optics, progressive native-pixel accumulation

indirectLighting.description: 80 cosine-weighted rays per vertex, one explicit colored surface bounce; terminal surface radiance uses precomputed direct-light visibility and ambient approximation. Static rest-pose cache. Four normal-aware smoothing iterations. Not an unbiased full path-tracing solution.

surfaceMaps.normalEncoding: tangent XYZ mapped 0..1; AO in alpha
surfaceMaps.source: Deterministic procedural surface processes; not photographed or scanned.

progressiveStudio.reconstruction: Three edge-aware a-trous passes; native-pixel depth/normal/variance guidance; biased
progressiveStudio.lightSampling: Three finite studio emitters plus the emissive crucible disk, BSDF/light MIS, Russian roulette
progressiveStudio.optics: Analytic solid lens and cut crystal, Fresnel sampling and Beer-Lambert absorption
progressiveStudio.limitations: Clamped sample radiance; straight-through next-event visibility across glass; composited flame; not an unbiased reference or 60-fps claim

secondaryRays.geometry: Full triangle geometry with four independently transformed roots
secondaryRays.terminalShading: Cached diffuse irradiance plus environment specular; not full path tracing

report.geometrySource: Parametric machined profiles, beveled surfaces, individual rotor blades, seeded branching foliage and stratified terrain. No sampled SDF normals.

photographicFocus.model: Stochastically sampled thin lens, 0.023 scene-unit aperture radius

passes.shadow: offline static area-light visibility; no live shadow-map pass

limitations: Mobile path is not a single full-screen fragment shader.
Meshes are parametrically rebuilt; this is not the original single-fragment scene.
Studio is progressive, not a guaranteed real-time renderer. The natural exhibits are still procedurally authored, not scans.
Live fallback probes are static. Geometry-traced optics use actual geometry, but their terminal lighting is approximate.

Live diffuse lighting is baked at rest. Studio recomputes light transport; its fire volume is composited, not a fluid simulation. Samples are clamped and direct glass-caustic connections are not solved.
